title: kit.build.v1
description: The answer of GET /api/build on every Worker a kit project deploys (@saasreport/cloudflare/build withBuild): the commit the Worker's version was deployed from (wrangler deploy --var BUILD_COMMIT:<sha>, so it is part of the version), and the builds of the Workers behind its service bindings under role keys (never an internal name: the answer is public). Read with no credential by `kit release verify` after every deploy and every day by the drift workflow. null means the version carries no commit (deployed from a shell): a drift. "unreachable" means a Worker behind a binding did not answer: unreadable, never a drift.
